schema_version: (integer, 2 or lower; 1 is migrated on load, default 1; a future version is an error)
name: (string, 1 to 64 chars starting with a letter or digit; letters, digits, space, underscore, dot, hyphen only; default: the theme folder name)
label: (string, max 120 chars; default: name)
author: (string, max 120 chars; default empty)

canvas.background: (paint, default transparent; paint: transparent | none | a color | a linear-gradient() or radial-gradient() string)

containers.id: (string, lowercase first char, 1 to 32 chars a-z 0-9 _ -; default container<index>)
containers.label: (string, max 80 chars; default: id)
containers.kind: (one of: scripture | freeform | any; default theme kind)

position.anchor: (one of: top_left | top_right | bottom_left | bottom_right | center | left | right | top | bottom | fill; default center)
position.x: (length, -10000 to 10000 px or %, default 0 when present)
position.y: (length, -10000 to 10000 px or %, default 0 when present)
position.top_left: (legacy boolean, true selects this corner only when anchor is absent, default false)

containers.width: (auto | length 0 to 7680 px or %, default auto)
containers.height: (auto | length 0 to 4320 px or %, default auto)
containers.max_width: (null | length 0 to 7680 px or %, default null)
containers.max_height: (null | length 0 to 4320 px or %, default null)

border.width: (number, 0 to 40 px; object form; omitted means no width; the whole border may instead be a CSS string such as "1px solid #ffffff", "none", or {"shared": "name"})
border.style: (one of: none | solid | dashed | dotted | double | groove | ridge | inset | outset; default solid)
border.color: (color: hex #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() string, or a named color such as white or transparent, default currentColor)
border.radius: (length 0 to 400 px; default 0; legacy alias of container border_radius)

top.style: (one of: none | solid | dashed | dotted | double | groove | ridge | inset | outset; default solid)
top.color: (color: hex #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() string, or a named color such as white or transparent, default currentColor)

right.style: (one of: none | solid | dashed | dotted | double | groove | ridge | inset | outset; default solid)
right.color: (color: hex #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() string, or a named color such as white or transparent, default currentColor)

bottom.style: (one of: none | solid | dashed | dotted | double | groove | ridge | inset | outset; default solid)
bottom.color: (color: hex #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() string, or a named color such as white or transparent, default currentColor)

left.style: (one of: none | solid | dashed | dotted | double | groove | ridge | inset | outset; default solid)
left.color: (color: hex #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() string, or a named color such as white or transparent, default currentColor)

containers.border_radius: (null | length 0 to 400 px or %, default 0; preferred over border.radius)

box_shadow.x: (number, -500 to 500 px, default 0; the whole shadow may instead be "none", a CSS shadow string, or {"shared": "name"})
box_shadow.color: (color: hex #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() string, or a named color such as white or transparent, default rgba(0,0,0,0.5))

containers.backdrop_filter: (none | CSS filter string; allowed functions and ranges: blur 0 to 60 px, brightness 0 to 4, contrast 0 to 4, saturate 0 to 8, grayscale 0 to 1, sepia 0 to 1, hue-rotate -1080 to 1080 deg, opacity 0 to 1; default none)

<animation-name>.type: (one of: fade_in | fade_out | fade_up | fade_down | scale_up | scale_down | slide_up | slide_down | typewriter | custom; required)

keyframes.at: (number, 0 to 100, must strictly increase; first frame 0, last frame 100)

_meta.generator: throwaway /tmp/gen_theme_atlas.py, not kept in the repo
_meta.reading: Every leaf value is a description in parentheses. A key shown as an object may also accept a CSS string or 'none' where its children say so. 'default' is the validator default after normalization, not necessarily what a new theme writes. Unknown keys survive round trips because validation keeps a note, not a rewrite, but they have no effect. The top-level animations object is the theme's local library; normalization replaces it in memory with the definitions actually referenced. Animation assignments are omitted by writing no phase, 'none', or no animation key; a slot may be an animation name string, {use, overrides}, or an inline definition, and a dict without 'use' is inline. cursor may also be the string 'none' or 'default'. Translation typography inherits from the reference block unless set explicitly.
_meta.verification: Two kitchen-sink themes (inline animations and use references, scripture and freeform) were normalized; the resolved key paths were compared with the atlas. Animation paths were compared by key name across both forms. The four legacy corner booleans and the string/shared-reference alternatives are accepted input that normalizes to an anchor or a canonical object, so they appear in the atlas but not in a resolved theme.

_discrepancies: containers[].blocks.body.visible is validated and preserved but display.js never reads it; the Designer now hides the control and containers[].visible is the supported switch.
containers[].kind is validated and preserved as authoring metadata; the Designer now hides the control because display.js renders every visible container regardless of kind.

verse_num size, weight, opacity, line_height, vertical_align and margin_right are applied to the inline number span by both renderers; position remains unsupported with its Designer control hidden and the stored value preserved; mode:block still renders no number.

text_shadow accepts a shared reference in the schema, but a block text shadow shared reference is not expanded by resolve_shared; the panel withholds shared options and both renderers paint no shadow for it. Object, CSS string and none forms are supported.
slide.show_title is validated, honoured by the slides tab and exposed as a freeform toggle on the Designer Canvas page; display.js still does not read it.
Animation registry parameter cursor.enabled exists only as a ParamForm visibility gate; it is not a stored key. Disabling it writes cursor: "none", and a cursor object has no enabled field.
containers[].position corner booleans (top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right) are legacy input accepted only when anchor is absent; no panel writes them and the validator warns about them.
containers[].padding_* is rejected with a warning (not a v2 parameter) and therefore absent from this atlas, while block padding is supported.
_uncertain: The renderer and the validator are mirrored by hand in display/display.js and ui/widgets/display_view.py; a key accepted by both may still be ignored in one path (for example the root theme path versus the v2 container path). Spot checks covered five leaves, not every combination.
Fonts are not a closed enum: font_family accepts any CSS family string that passes the safe-character regex, so the atlas lists the default families rather than a registry.
Shared references ({"shared": "name"}) resolve from theme family files; their available names are data, not schema, so they are not enumerated.
